name: patronus-security
description: Patronus Runtime Protection and explicit security scans for Codex.

interface.longDescription: For supported local Codex chats, Patronus checks user-prompt text and tool/MCP-result text before model delivery using the separately installed Patronus Security CLI and reviewed, trusted hooks. Run explicitly requested security scans, configure detection levels in the local dashboard, or pause individual chats. Media bytes and tool arguments are outside the scan boundary. If scanning is unavailable, tools continue and content is marked unverified. Cloud-orchestrated Work does not support these plugin hooks. This runtime package is distributed through local/repo marketplaces; public submission currently excludes lifecycle hooks.
defaultPrompt: Scan this repository with Patronus Security.
Scan this file with Patronus Security.
Review the latest Patronus scan report and explain its coverage.
